cbas.title: 🪸 Coral Bleaching Alert System
cbas.subtitle: INCOIS CBAS · Satellite Thermal Stress Monitoring
cbas.guide_title: ℹ️ What do these metrics mean?
cbas.hotspot_def: Instantaneous Sea Surface Temperature (SST) anomaly above the maximum monthly mean — indicates immediate thermal stress.
cbas.dhw_def: Thermal stress accumulated over a 12-week window (°C-weeks) — indicates bleaching severity and potential mortality risk.
abis.title: 🌿 Algal Bloom Information Services (ABIS)
abis.subtitle: INCOIS · Detection & Monitoring of Bloom in the Indian Seas
abis.overview: INCOIS Algal Bloom Information Services (ABIS) provides near real-time spatio-temporal detection and spread monitoring of phytoplankton blooms over the North Indian Ocean (0°–31°N & 35°E–103°E) to safeguard fisheries, mariculture, and marine ecosystems.
abis.hotspot_a_desc: Characterized by seasonal winter-spring green Noctiluca scintillans blooms, high chlorophyll anomalies, and associated subsurface hypoxia.
abis.hotspot_b_desc: Monsoon coastal upwelling zone susceptible to mixed diatom blooms, red Noctiluca, and localized fish asphyxia.
abis.hotspot_c_desc: Ecologically sensitive biosphere reserve monitoring coral reef health, mariculture habitats, and micro-plankton surges.
abis.hotspot_d_desc: North-Western Bay of Bengal coastal region tracking riverine nutrient discharge, diatom blooms, and pelagic fishery complement.

tchp.title: 🌪️ Tropical Cyclone Heat Potential (TCHP)
tchp.subtitle: INCOIS-ROMS 5-Day Ocean Thermal Energy Forecast
tchp.guide_desc: Tropical Cyclone Heat Potential measures integrated upper-ocean thermal energy down to the 26°C isotherm. High TCHP (>80 kJ/cm²) prevents cyclone-induced cooling and fuels severe cyclone intensification.
